substrate_orientation: Si wafers with a (100) orientation 3° tilted toward the [011] zone
pretreatment: Substrates were loaded into the reactor after the HF dipping. Before growth started, the substrates were heated at 1000 °C for 20 min in H2 to evaporate the surface oxidized layer.
